_comment: Manually update these values after each billing period or credit top-up. Scan jobs read this file before consuming credits — if remaining <= 0 the job logs a warning and skips rather than burning quota silently.

shodan.note: Shodan free tier: 1 query credit per search. Check https://account.shodan.io after each scan.

censys.note: Censys free non-commercial tier. Verify current allowance at https://search.censys.io/account.

nvd.note: NVD API free tier: 50 req/30s with API key, 5 req/30s without. Set NVD_API_KEY in .env.
